title: SHA mapping — UNRELATED_FORK_FEATURE replay (Class B preservation)
method: Whole-file replay: git -C <legacy> show a3ab319:<path> written verbatim (fd-redirected, byte-exact; verified by git blob SHA-1 equality). All 10 files have empty mixed_hunks in the provenance manifest, so no hunk-level selection was required. legacy_blob = `git rev-parse a3ab319:<path>` (object identity in the legacy object db). host_blob = `git rev-parse HEAD:<path>` in the host worktree after the replay commit. content_sha256 = SHA-256 of the replayed bytes.
